notes: Explored how translational tracking (X, Y, Z) enables motion parallax, which is the primary depth cue absent in 3DoF. Key insight: without 6DoF, user presence drops drastically and virtual menus feel pasted on the eyeballs.
takeaway: Translational motion parallax is the core differentiator for physical presence in spatial environments.
resources: Apple Human Interface Guidelines - Spatial Layout

topic: Field of View (FOV) and Ergonomic Comfort Zones
notes: Mapped out comfortable viewing angles: primary content should sit within +/- 15 degrees vertically and +/- 30 degrees horizontally from resting eye vector to avoid neck fatigue.
takeaway: Never place high-frequency interactive elements outside the 30-degree central cone of vision.
resources: Designing for Spatial Computing - Ergonomics Paper
